description: What a global setup's globalConfig.testPathPatterns is (T9.15): in Jest 30 a TestPathPatterns object (jest-pattern), not an array, with `patterns`, `isSet()`, `isValid()`, `toPretty()` (the patterns joined with `|`), `toJSON()` and `toExecutor({ rootDir })`, whose executor has `isSet`, `isValid`, `isMatch(absolutePath)` and `toPretty`. The setup writes what it saw to seen.txt, which the black-box run captures. Two patterns on the command line: one a plain regular expression, one anchored with `./`, which Jest reads as `^`.
